text: Stone Energy has successfully completed a zone change to the L-22 Sand from the R-1 Sand. The operation entailed isolating the existing R-1 Sand by dumping a 50' cement plug on a TTBP set at 8069'MD. The L-22 Sand was then perforated from 8004'MD-8014'MD. Note: Decision was made to cease operations prior to running sand control due to difficulties running in & out of the wellbore w/ slickline & e-line. An informational e-mail was sent 06-13-2013 informing BSEE of this decision.

The operation entailed isolating the existing R-1 Sand by dumping a 50' cement plug on a TTBP set at 8069'MD. The L-22 Sand was then perforated from 8004'MD-8014'MD. Note: Decision was made to cease operations prior to running sand control due to difficulties running in & out of the wellbore w/ slickline & e-line. An informational e-mail was sent 06-13-2013 informing BSEE of this decision.
